name: FedEx Freight Hub - Earth City MO (St. Louis, STL)
type: Freight LTL hub service center (~240 doors)

fieldNotes.location: Roster address '3300 Rider Trl S, Earth City MO' and coordinates (38.761891, -90.455962, ROOFTOP) resolve to a multi-story glass OFFICE building in the Earth City office park - NOT a freight hub. The correct FedEx Freight STL break-bulk hub is at 3951 New Town Blvd, St Charles, MO 63301, centered approximately 38.8350, -90.5210 (across the Missouri River, ~9 km NW of the roster point). Confirmed by satellite showing a classic LTL break-bulk cross-dock building with hundreds of trailers, and by the FedEx Freight STL service-center locator page (local.fedex.com/mo/saint-charles/freight-STL).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Large dedicated LTL hub property; truck yard access controlled via the New Town Blvd access road on the south/SW side. Perimeter is defined; exact gate position inferred from the access corridor (Street View coverage near the gate is limited). FedEx Freight break-bulk hubs are universally gated.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Not directly resolved in available imagery. A ~240-door break-bulk hub is staffed-guard-controlled at the truck gate as a FedEx Freight network standard; classified true with medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long E-W cross-dock break-bulk building with a dense regular rhythm of dock doors on both long faces plus a perpendicular north wing; trailers backed in along both faces. Cited in trucking forums as a ~240-door hub - firmly 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Vast paved trailer drop yard north and east of the cross-dock holds hundreds of parked trailers/pups without tractors, including organized rows; firmly 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lots flank the cross-dock on the north and east sides.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large paved yard between the gate and the docks provides ample room for a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved approach and large yard near the gate give physical room to add a dedicated bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated 2 inbound / 2 outbound lanes at the controlled gate; exact count not resolvable from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main cross-dock break-bulk building (with north wing), an office/dispatch building at the south face, and a separate maintenance/shop building on the east side = 3.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; classified false.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the perimeter box (~534m x ~650m), ~86 acres.
